description_detailed: This collector coin marks the 70th anniversary of Walt Disney Animation Studio’s Lady and the Tramp, in 2025. Lady lives a pampered life with her beloved owners, Jim Dear and Darling, knowing little of the outside world. When they leave on vacation, Aunt Sarah puts a muzzle on her, and Lady runs away in fear. Cornered by street dogs, she’s saved by Tramp, a free-spirited mutt with no home or rules. Though from very different worlds, Tramp shows Lady the adventure and charm of life beyond the fence. From meeting new friends to a candlelit dinner at Tony’s, Lady begins to see him in a new light. She’s hurt when she believes Tramp has let her down, but her heart softens, and she forgives. Despite their differences, the two are a perfect match. Tramp soon finds a place not just in her heart, but in her home. Together, they live happily ever after.
